 route-target export 65000:200
 route-target import 65000:200
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/3.200
 description CE_CUSTOMER-B_NYC_CID:CUST-B-NYC-001
 encapsulation dot1Q 200

!
router bgp 65000

  neighbor 10.200.0.2 remote-as 65200

tests.name: Configure IPSec tunnel with PSK
tests.input:
Set up IPSec tunnel between 203.0.113.1 (EDGE-RTR-01) and 198.51.100.1 (REMOTE-GW-01) with PSK MyTunnelKey99.

Generated config for EDGE-RTR-01:
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encr aes 256
 hash sha256
 authentication pre-share
 group 14
 lifetime 86400
!
crypto isakmp key MyTunnelKey99 address 198.51.100.1
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-AES256-SHA esp-aes 256 esp-sha256-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto map CMAP-IPSEC 10 ipsec-isakmp
 description TUNNEL_TO_REMOTE-GW-01
 set peer 198.51.100.1
 set transform-set TS-AES256-SHA
 match address ACL-IPSEC-INTERESTING
!
ip access-list extended ACL-IPSEC-INTERESTING
 permit ip 10.1.0.0 0.0.255.255 10.2.0.0 0.0.255.255
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description WAN_TO_ISP_LUMEN
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 crypto map CMAP-IPSEC
!
interface Tunnel0
 description IPSEC_TO_REMOTE-GW-01
 ip address 10.254.0.1 255.255.255.252
 tunnel source 203.0.113.1
 tunnel destination 198.51.100.1
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel protection ipsec profile IPSEC-PROFILE-01
